adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates Google Calendar’s `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` to select the matching destination calendar via `find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`. In contrast, `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` still derives the target calendar solely from the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then uses its `externalId` in the events URL). Meanwhile, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over `event.destinationCalendar` to create events per destination/credential, but `CalendarManager.createEvent` only passes `credential.id` to the calendar service (no externalId), so the Office365 service has no way to pick the correct per-credential destination calendar and will incorrectly use index 0 for all hosts.
